profile.headline: Software Developer at Northwestern University - The Feinberg School of Medicine
profile.summary: Developer with a constant desire to cultivate and grow my skills and to always be improving!

company.name: Northwestern University - The Feinberg School of Medicine

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, United States · On-site

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
• Fullstack software development, including API, console, and web applications, using JavaScript, C# and .NET.
• Worked directly with developers to maintain best standards and baseline performance within the SQL Server environment.
• Generated SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) reports.
• Performed basic Database Administration tasks in a Microsoft SQL Server Environment.
• Developed throughout the SDLC including requirements gathering with customers, technical
specifications and planning with senior developers, and coding.
• Worked on existing codebases developed by senior developers.
• Managed separate development environments via GitHub Enterprise.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Data Modeling · ASP.NET Core · HTML · JavaScript · Web Development · GitHub · ASP.NET Web API · C# · Powershell · Software Development · ASP.NET MVC · Query Tuning · Git · Algorithms · API Development · .NET Core · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
・Repaired, annotated, and refactored a defective data pipeline process, using Python, and modern
libraries such as Pandas and SQLAlchemy.
・ Collaborated with engineers in an Agile environment to find iterative ETL solutions within Python,
SQL and Power BI.
・ Process allowed network engineers to quickly and accurately assess the status of national networks
and routers and made sure devices were working properly.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · MySQL · Python · Python (Programming Language) · Git · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
・Helped a tenured professor with the undergraduate network infrastructure course. 
・Wrote the exams and assisted students with labs and homework. Topics included subnetting, address resolution, binary, OSI model etc.

positions.title: Accounting Systems
positions.description:
・Lead the implementation of Alteryx for the Indirect Tax Team and was the first in the company to use the software. 
・Generated workflow processes for various states to increase efficiency for tax reconciliations. 
・Applied my knowledge of programming to generate the processes within Alteryx and was given a great perspective into the corporate work environment.

positions.title: Production Assistant/EVS Operator
positions.description: Worked in a broadcast environment in a team of part-time students like myself as well as full-time broadcast professionals with industry experience. It was a fantastic opportunity to learn the ins and outs of the broadcast world, and to see the amount of effort that goes into each and every telecast. Tasked with generating replays and highlights in a timely manner in a high-stress environment.
